objects: one complete-card-admitted instant or sorcery with Jump-start
costs: the printed mana cost and one card discarded as an additional cost
timing: ordinary timing for the resulting instant or sorcery
targets: ordinary spell targets are independent from the discard payment
choices: the owner privately selects one hand card to discard
hidden_information: the discard choice is owner-private until the public discard occurs
apnap: the discard event enters the ordinary trigger batch
layers: the shared current-component query gates the graveyard ability
replacement_effects: the discard uses canonical destination replacement and the jump-started spell's self-replacement precedes ambient stack departure replacements
copy: copied, granted, text-changed, and repeated Jump-start forms remain unsupported
control_change: spell control does not transfer ownership of the discarded or exiled cards
zone_change: resolution, countering, and every other represented stack departure exile the physical jump-started card
source_leaves: the current stack incarnation alone carries the self-replacement

implementation.supported_slice: One intrinsic bare Jump-start declaration on a complete instant or sorcery using its printed cost, one typed discard, and the canonical stack self-replacement.

known_blockers: copied, granted, text-changed, repeated, and incomplete-card forms
alternative-cost combinations and independently unsupported spell bodies
